## Claims checklist

Tick every box before requesting review. `npm run check:claims` enforces most
of this, but the guard cannot judge whether a new number is true.

- [ ] No disease, treatment, or diagnostic claim added
- [ ] No anti-aging, lifespan, or senolytic claim added
- [ ] Any new figure traces to a primary source, or is labelled as a target
- [ ] Hemp language stays hempseed-derived only (no CBD, no THC)
- [ ] Colorant language matches the locked decision (Galdieria primary)
- [ ] `npm run check` passes locally
